fix_applied: Replaced all occurrences of request.session.get('user') (dict pattern) with request.session.get('user_id') (integer) to align with the login handler's session key convention, fixing the session mismatch that was masking the IDOR. Added an ownership check on GET /orders/{order_id} and GET /orders/{order_id}/confirm: after fetching the order by ID, if order.user_id != user_id (the authenticated user), an HTTPException with status_code=403 and detail 'Access forbidden: you do not own this order.' is raised.
verification_result: 403 Forbidden — access correctly denied: alice (user_id=3) attempting to access order 1 (owned by user, user_id=2) received HTTP 403, confirming the ownership check is enforced.
